name: How long does a typical home modernization project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home modernization project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home modernization project depends heavily on its complexity and scope. Smaller projects, such as updating a single room or minor cosmetic changes, might take a few weeks. Larger renovations, like a full kitchen or bathroom remodel, typically span 4 to 12 weeks. Whole-home modernizations or significant structural changes can extend from several months to a year or more. Simply Construction provides a detailed project schedule and keeps you informed of progress throughout the renovation, managing timelines efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary: small updates take weeks, while major renovations can take months to over a year, depending on complexity. Your contractor will provide a detailed schedule.
